environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in private subnet. SQS queue policy allows SendMessage from any authenticated AWS principal. The consumer processes messages from any sender who can push to the queue. No message signing validation beyond the JWT in the message body. Public key is stored in environment variable and is retrievable from the service's /health endpoint (leaked in debug mode). Internet-facing API gateway forwards task submissions to SQS.

config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Java 17, aws-java-sdk 1.12.x, auth0 java-jwt 4.2.1
config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, no inbound restrictions on SQS
config.public_key_exposure: Public key available at /health endpoint in debug mode
config.cloudfront: Distribution serves origin content, no signed URL requirement
